extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners, petitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO, and Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_short: petition for reinstatement to USPTO practice
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision process for a petition to reinstate an individual to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including required filings and the Director's review. Focuses on procedural compliance (e.g., affidavits under 37 CFR § 11.58) and discretionary determination of appropriateness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Schulman has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision cites filing an affidavit under 37 CFR § 11.58 as part of the petition record, implying that petitions for reinstatement should include an affidavit compliant with that regulation. The page does not specify the affidavit's required contents; see the regulation for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review and discretionary determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition and supporting documents, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement depends on the Director's review of the petition and supporting materials; the Director exercises discretion to grant or deny reinstatement based on the sufficiency of those materials. The document provides no further scoring rules or factors considered.
